column1: # Subramaniam 2018 mFI-5 — OMOP concept ID mappings.
# Source: Subramaniam S et al. J Am Coll Surg 2018;226(2):173-181e8.
# All concept IDs below are [vocab query] entries sourced from
# phenotype_library/catalog.yaml. Each row cites its catalog entry id so that
#   Two SNOMED ancestors used as OR logic (include_descendants = TRUE):
#   The catalog's full mFI multi-concept OR composite (including Barthel
#   index value-coded queries) is intentionally simplified here to two
#   ancestors. Barthel queries require value_as_concept_id filtering which
#   is not supported by the integer_risk_score pipeline's default condition
#   include_descendants  TRUE = expand via concept_ancestor rollup
#   concept_role         blank (no special role for mFI-5 components)
#   value_concept_ids    blank (no value-coded observations in this minimal set)
